## Official ICUAC Release

This Release is built automatically from the source tagged `v{{VERSION}}` in the official [Lazyzouo/ICUAC](https://github.com/Lazyzouo/ICUAC) repository. To avoid installing the wrong or modified build, use only one of these two official plugin assets:

- `ICUAC-{{VERSION}}-en.us.jar`: English is the official default language.
- `ICUAC-{{VERSION}}-zh.cn.jar`: Simplified Chinese is the official default language.

Both JARs contain identical plugin code and features. Each includes a complete official preset with language-appropriate messages and comments; the distribution difference is the first-run default language. GitHub records a SHA-256 digest for each asset, which ICUAC also uses for automatic-update verification.

GitHub may display automatically generated **Source code** archives. They are repository snapshots, not installable plugin JARs. Files from third-party sites, renamed files, modified builds, and reuploads are not official ICUAC releases.

**Tested:** Paper/Folia 1.21.11 · **Java bytecode:** 21 · **Author:** Lazyz

## ICUAC 官方发布

本 Release 由官方 [Lazyzouo/ICUAC](https://github.com/Lazyzouo/ICUAC) 仓库中标记为 `v{{VERSION}}` 的源码自动构建。为避免安装错误版本或被修改的文件，请只使用以下两个官方插件资源之一：

- `ICUAC-{{VERSION}}-en.us.jar`：官方默认语言为英文。
- `ICUAC-{{VERSION}}-zh.cn.jar`：官方默认语言为简体中文。

两个 JAR 包含完全相同的插件代码与功能，并分别提供具有对应语言消息和注释的完整官方预设；发行差异仅为首次启动时的默认语言。GitHub 会为每个资源记录 SHA-256 摘要，ICUAC 自动更新器也使用该摘要进行校验。

GitHub 页面可能显示平台自动生成的 **Source code** 源码压缩包；它们是仓库快照，不是可安装的插件 JAR。第三方网站提供的文件、被重命名或修改的构建以及转载文件均不属于 ICUAC 官方发行版。

**测试版本：** Paper/Folia 1.21.11 · **Java 字节码：** 21 · **作者：** Lazyz
